referenceSources.description:
This pristine Grandprix White Porsche 964 Carrera RSR 3.8 is one of only 51 factory-built racing examples produced between April 1993 and December 1994. Chassis no. WPO ZZZ 96 ZPS 496096 was first campaigned by Nova Engineering in Japan, including the 1,000 KM of Suzuka, and achieved class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, Nürburgring, and Spa in 1993.

Restored by Freisinger Motorsport in Germany in 2007, the car features a 3.8 L naturally aspirated flat-six engine with 350 hp, a 5-speed racing gearbox, roll cage, Recaro seat, 120 L safety tank, and fire suppression system. Its wide body, large rear wing, and center-lock BBS-style wheels highlight its competition pedigree, while the black fabric interior and matching numbers confirm its authenticity.
